papers.title: The First Deep Learning all-sky List of Fermi-LAT Gamma-ray Sources
papers.summary: Deep-learning pipeline using U-Net and DNNs on simulated Fermi-LAT data produces first all-sky gamma-ray source list of >3800 sources.
papers.tldr: The first Fermi-LAT {\gamma}-ray all-sky source list derived using a deep-learning-based method (1FDL), containing more than 3800 sources with estimated positions, fluxes, and probability scores that quantify the likelihood of each detection being genuine or spurious.

papers.title: COSMIO: A Benchmark for Cross-Survey Modality Imputation
papers.summary: COSMIO benchmark forward-renders aligned LSST, Euclid, Roman scenes to test cross-survey modality imputation, revealing poor transfer and rare-event lens challenges.
papers.tldr: COSMIO is introduced, a multi-survey benchmark of aligned observations obtained by forward-rendered shared astrophysical scenes across LSST, Euclid, and Roman under survey-specific instrument characteristics, which enables systematic evaluation of imputation across source-target survey combinations and missing-survey patterns.

papers.title: Spin Spherical Fourier Neural Operators: Efficient Equivariant Learning for Vector and Spin Fields on the Sphere
papers.summary: Spin spherical Fourier neural operators extend SFNOs to equivariant vector and spin fields on the sphere, matching machine-precision equivariance and state-of-the-art benchmarks.
papers.tldr: This work extends spherical Fourier neural operators (SFNOs) to fields of any spin, through lifted spherical convolutions that are exactly rotationally equivariant, and demonstrates empirically that rotational equivariance holds to machine precision for these layers.

papers.title: Feature-Based and Deep Learning Methods for Astronomical Light Curve Classification
papers.comment: 14 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Moscow University Physics Bulletin (DLCP-2026 special issue)
papers.summary: Comparing feature-based ML and end-to-end deep learning on 40,000 ZTF light curves, classical features outperform deep networks for variable star classification.
papers.tldr: It is found that limited labeled data contributes to the performance gap, while the multivariate, irregularly sampled, and morphologically diverse nature of light curves poses additional challenges for deep learning models.

papers.title: Macrocanonical Generator Networks: Data-Efficient Neural Surrogates for Amortized Physics Simulation
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages total (inc. appendices), 4 figures
papers.summary: Macrocanonical generator networks learn data-efficient neural surrogates by matching multiscale statistics, recovering cosmology and fluid simulations from tiny training sets over 10^6 times faster.
papers.tldr: It is proved that gradient-descent training induces preconditioned gradient-descent dynamics in sample space that inherit the symmetry-preservation properties of the microcanonical gradient descent of Bruna and Mallat, amortizing its per-sample inner-loop optimization into a single training run after which every sample is generated in one forward pass.

papers.title: A semi-autonomous multi-agent pipeline for high-energy astrophysics research with enforced provenance and verifiable self-extension
papers.summary: Semi-autonomous LLM multi-agent pipeline retrieves HEASARC data, writes and validates tools with provenance checks, reproducing IXPE Cyg X-1 results.

papers.title: Structural axes of sources in the SUMSS survey and their alignments
papers.summary: CNN-derived position angles for 4087 SUMSS radio sources show no statistically significant local alignments after look-elsewhere calibration, providing a southern-sky morphology catalogue.

papers.title: A Unified AI Framework for Rapid and Accurate Waveform Generation of Compact Binary Coalescences
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material included
papers.summary: Deep-learning generator produces black-hole, neutron-star, and mixed-binary waveforms including spin, matter, and postmerger effects, with mismatches 5.9e-4–5.3e-2 and up to 1800× speedup.

papers.title: SBi3PCF: cosmology with Dark Energy Survey Year 3 cosmic shear
papers.comment: 20 pages (4 figures, 6 tables) + appendices. Comments are welcome!
papers.summary: Simulation-based inference of integrated three-point cosmic shear from DES Y3, combined with two-point functions, tightens cosmological constraints and yields Ωm=0.272, S8=0.784, w0=-1.04.
